archetype: Electric & Neon meets Swiss High-Contrast (Occult Cyber-Brutalism)

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl tracking-tighter uppercase font-black text-[#F4F0EB]
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl tracking-tight uppercase font-bold text-[#F4F0EB]
hierarchy.h3: text-xl sm:text-2xl tracking-tight uppercase font-medium text-[#F5A623]
hierarchy.label: text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-[#D11124] font-bold

spacing_and_layout.global: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8, p-12. Avoid cramped UI.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: Grid layout using wide gaps (gap-8) and asymmetrical column spanning. Avoid perfect symmetry to create tension.
spacing_and_layout.container_padding: Generous padding inside bordered containers (p-6 to p-8) to avoid text collision with borders.
spacing_and_layout.hud_style: Use absolute positioning for decorative corner brackets and terminal-like indicators. Clip paths for slanted container edges where appropriate.
spacing_and_layout.corners: Strictly sharp corners. Use 'rounded-none' for all elements to enforce brutalism.

surfaces_and_borders.cards: Flat solid #0A0A0A backgrounds with 1px #D11124/30 borders. No soft shadows. Use inner glow or drop-shadows with sharp offsets if needed.
surfaces_and_borders.glassmorphism: Used only for HUD overlays: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050505]/80 with a 1px border of red/20 or amber/20.
surfaces_and_borders.retro_futurism: Terminal warfare look: Deep black backgrounds with neon amber or red borders, scanline background patterns, and subtle text shadows for a glowing effect.
surfaces_and_borders.buttons: Brutalist buttons: sharp edges, bright blood-red or amber backgrounds for primary actions, high contrast #F4F0EB text. Hover effect: sharp transform offset (-translate-y-1, translate-x-1) with a solid shadow.

animations.hover_states: Hard transitions, no soft fading. Instant text color change and border color shifts.
animations.entrance: Staggered 'glitch-in' or opacity/transform sweeps for panels opening.
animations.active: Subtle pulsing glow (opacity changes) for active HP/Energy bars to mimic life signs.

components.buttons: Use HTML/Tailwind buttons with 'rounded-none', 1px borders, uppercase mono text. Include geometric decorators (e.g., small squares or slash lines in the button).
components.inputs: Shadcn heavily customized: transparent background, bottom border only or sharp 1px full border, #F5A623 focus ring.
components.panels: Data screens (inventory, stats) use strict 'Control Room' grids with dense mono-spaced data tables.
components.bars: HP/Energy bars use bold gradient fills with dark #050505 track backgrounds and segmented vertical overlay lines to look like mechanical gauges.
components.dialogs: Story panels should look like secure encrypted transmissions. Use typing effects for text reveal.

hero_bg.description: Abstract background texture blending deep black void with glowing amber gold and blood red circuitry patterns, glitch art style.

combat_bg.description: Turn-based combat arena background, desolate futuristic wasteland under a dying red sun.

world_map.description: Dark sci-fi planetary map HUD background, deep space black with glowing gold and red cartography lines.

character_portrait.description: Cinematic 3D render of a futuristic cybernetic character in a dark dystopian space station.

ruins_reference.description: Dramatic sunset with fiery red clouds over trees, serving as atmospheric lighting reference.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a custom Layout container using strict dark theme (bg-[#050505]). Do NOT use standard light mode elements anywhere.
Implement the following screens: 1) Login/Register HUD, 2) Character Creation/Selection, 3) World Map / Mission Hub, 4) Turn-based Combat Arena, 5) Stats & Inventory Panels.
For all UI elements, enforce sharp geometry. Use 'rounded-none'. Avoid soft shadows; use solid block shadows or CSS glows (drop-shadow).
Integrate 'glitch' or scanline CSS effects on header backgrounds or critical alert states to emphasize the cyberpunk/post-apocalyptic theme.
All text content is pre-written (no AI narrative needed), but style story panels like secure military or occult transmissions.

In the Combat Arena, use 'combat_bg' as a full-screen background with a vignette or dark overlay to ensure UI legibility. Position action buttons (Attack, Skill, Defend, Item) in an asymmetric, dense control-room layout.
Ensure ALL interactive elements and key information displays include descriptive `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='login-button'`, `data-testid='health-bar'`).
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all numeric values, stats, action logs, and small labels. Use 'Unbounded' for major screen titles and critical alerts.
Add 'lucide-react' for HUD icons, keeping them sharp and monochromatic (white, red, or amber).
Install Google Fonts in index.html or global CSS: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Unbounded:wght@300;400;700;900&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700;800&display=swap');
